authority: Test Lead's f02 menu-v2 / 24-context / continuous-TRAIN decision, 2026-10-11, under owner's 2026-10-10 value-bar delegation; F02-MENU-V2-REGISTRATION

battery-v3.decision_scope: five-band ambient-indexed battery-v3 charge map, all mandatory 30-cycle conditions per candidate
battery-v3.justification: 24 complete five-band maps is a prospective local-plus-global design exploration with final verification; the older 91 CPU-second single-action context does not price this v3 map. Eight allocated-host hours and 24 CPU core-hours allow startup, refinement, screening and failed proposals but are unmeasured buyer spend.

motor.decision_scope: revised motor 10p/12s double-layer and three-slice skew, complete command-angle-skew geometry panel
motor.justification: No measured current full-panel cost exists. Twelve complete geometries and 24 wall/96 CPU core-hours are a prospective constrained multistart-and-DOE budget, with 6 and 24 geometry sensitivity tiers; the unrelated TEAM 25 sample count is method context, not this buyer's budget.

f02.decision_scope: f02 menu v2: one of 24 registered contexts, 16 finite peak/on-time actions per context; public continuous TRAIN separate from held-out menu
f02.justification: ASSUMPTION: a competent direct route can enumerate all 16 discrete actions per context. Historical 2-3 CPU-minutes per waveform is a lower anchor, not complete refinement/setup cost. Four wall and core-hours per context allow solver verification, setup, failed attempts and boundary refinement; actual buyer spend remains unmeasured. The 24 contexts are a panel, not 24 independent buyer jobs.

f13.decision_scope: original offset two-chamber 3D f13 silencer, full 500-2500 Hz curve with mandatory refinement; conditional coaxial reframe excluded
f13.justification: Owner-reported original full curves cost above two CPU-hours and have unresolved tails. Eight full curves, 16 wall-hours and 32 CPU core-hours are a prospective multi-core design review allowance; the doubled 16-curve tier reaches the proposed finite bank. Neither buyer allocation nor corrected-route runtime is measured.
